title: The presentation values the client reads: the renderer's and the terrain's look keys of M1 (owner decision O75, ADR-116).
description: One record, GameData/Records/tuning/presentation.json, client-only and never simulation-relevant. Each field path is its tuning key (CONVENTIONS §4).
